name: Frozen binary readout precision diagnosis
stage: Specified after the parent proposal and fixed-cardinality diagnostics, before any new precision comparison
question: Do low-precision final logits explain frequent score ties, and do higher-precision readouts improve within-case ranking without changing learned weights?
shared_forward: Use the exact parent label-blind all-zero answer-prefix encoding and frozen model/adapter. All readouts share the same twenty hidden states from one backbone forward.

readouts.native: Original quantized full-vocabulary output projection; extract token 0/1 logits and cast the completed logits to float32, exactly as in the parent scorer.
readouts.fp32_binary: Reconstruct only token 0/1 weight rows in float32 from the same packed four-bit weights, stored scales and affine offsets. Multiply the original hidden states cast to float32 by these two rows. Backbone and stored quantization parameters are unchanged.
readouts.fp32_rerounded: Round fp32_binary logits to bfloat16, then cast back to float32 before the same binary softmax. Its difference from fp32_binary isolates final-logit rounding within the new dense readout path.

interpretation: Native versus fp32_binary changes projection arithmetic as well as final precision. Native versus fp32_rerounded measures residual implementation differences. Do not attribute all native/FP32 differences solely to final-logit rounding. Hidden states and backbone weights remain quantized; this is not a full-float32 model.
runtime_preflight: Two explicitly synthetic, nonclinical prompts per frozen state. Independently unpack four-bit rows and reconstruct weights using NumPy float64; independently recompute dense logits, softmax and bfloat16 rounding. Record dtypes, unique scores and numerical residuals. Synthetic tie changes are not clinical performance.
proposal_plan: After a passing preflight and frozen evaluator/auditor, evaluate all six states on all 100 parent proposal admissions in ranked/permuted views, batch size four. Save hidden states and all three readouts privately for independent CPU readout replay. Use both previously declared identity-based tie rules to select eight medications; retain the original retrieval top-eight control, all reference medications, within-case AUROC, cutoff ties, score alignment and paired patient intervals. Do not recalibrate thresholds, train, promote a state or open a test.
guard_plan: Only after the original parent guard inference and independent audit complete; no guard-based choices. The guard remains reused development data.
clinical_execution_gate: Do not run the clinical precision comparison until the synthetic preflight and the dedicated evaluator/auditor implementation are both complete and source-bound. A preflight alone is not clinical execution.
statistical_scope: Post-proposal descriptive diagnosis, one training seed. 4000 paired patient bootstrap draws, seed 32032, no multiplicity adjustment. No independent confirmation or feedback-specific RSI claim.
privacy_and_budget: No API requests. New backbone forwards and projection arithmetic must be counted. Restricted hidden states, cases, labels and selections stay local; publish only aggregates and source hashes.
